scope: Seven concrete authoring-error withdrawals selected from two closed-review audits. This is not a count of all errors or measured time saved. All have completed successors; no revival is recommended.
current_source: Current generic request authoring derives landing targets but does not provide a dedicated review-request constructor. The verdict guard and Resolve already own exact examined-set and binding checks. Current review queue recognizes body.artifact; it cannot infer review intent from prose.
design_constraints: Explicit primary, companions, reviewer, conditions and authority mode; never automatically sweep every artifact at a head.
Derive full commit and canonical IDs from selected verified evidence/checkout; shared resolver checks artifact/head/binding.
Prepare is advisory, creates no event and gives no approval. Filing repeats applicable checks at the actual frontier.
Keep ordinary stale-basis handling and all current authority/independence/merge rules.
